citations.claim: energy just before collision is below initial, no prior buildup
energy still below initial while bodies are in near-contact
first violating step: energy jumps ~275J in one step during body-body contact, exceeding allowed bound

counterfactual.change: Changed only body 1 restitution e from ~0.949 to 0.0; with inelastic contact the same 42-step run stays below initial energy and no rule is violated, showing high-restitution bounce injects the energy.

explanation: With controller disabled (work 0), total energy should not exceed initial + tolerance. Bodies 0 (heavy, 15.6kg) and 1 (light, 1kg, e~0.95) collide around steps 40-42 (gap ~0.01-0.05). In one step 41->42 energy jumps from ~957J to ~1231J (+275J) while speeds of both bodies increase. Likely cause: body-body impulse with high restitution combined with positional correction / multi-substep contact resolution adds net energy, amplified by large mass ratio, instead of dissipating it.
vision_note: A tiny blue circle approaches and touches a much larger blue circle parked at the base of a thin vertical wall across steps 39 to 41. In step 42 the tiny circle is suddenly offset down-left from the large circle while the large circle has shifted, showing an abrupt energetic bounce from the contact.
